title: Larger Role for Singapore in Realising ASEAN Power Grid
what_it_is: Larger Role for Singapore in Realising ASEAN Power Grid

sections.label: ASEAN power grid cooperation
sections.summary: Singapore works with ASEAN states and partners on pathfinder projects, MOUs and studies to advance regional energy connectivity and decarbonisation.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The support of all ASEAN member states is necessary to realise this vision.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: And Singapore is committed to playing our part.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Singapore has been working with various countries on pathfinder projects such as the Lao People's Democratic Republic (PDR)-Thailand-Malaysia-Singapore Power Integration Project.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We have also signed several Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) with like-minded countries such as Cambodia, Lao PDR and Vietnam – and I think Members know, with Indonesia as well – to advance our collective energy interests and facilitate regional decarbonisation.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Last week, Indonesia and Singapore signed the MOU on Renewable Energy Cooperation where we will collaborate on cross-border electricity trading projects.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We are also working with the United States on a feasibility study on regional energy connectivity to support the development of the ASEAN Power Grid.

sections.label: No direct cross-border investment
sections.summary: The Government does not intend to invest directly in cross-border infrastructure, instead working with regional partners on frameworks and regulations for commercial players.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: At this point in time, the Government does not intend to invest directly in cross-border infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Our focus is to work with regional partners to provide the framework, regulations as well as the ecosystem that will enable commercial players to build the infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We will continue to work closely with all of our regional partners and with this year's ASEAN Chair, Indonesia, to realise the ASEAN Power Grid.
